provenance.note: The cheap half of ADR 0007's two-phase poll: no content=true. Each posting is byte-identical to the live response; only the set was reduced (429 -> 25). Nothing inside a posting was edited or synthesised.

what_this_fixture_proves.why_it_matters: updated_at is what the phase-2 diff compares on, and Greenhouse is the only one of the three providers that publishes it. content must be absent — a listing that carried descriptions would make the 15x saving imaginary.
